name: 暁
prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit image 1 locally ONLY the visible printed face of the single card held near his left shoulder. Replace the invented crown-and-crossed-cutlery card printing with the adopted Battle à la Carte card back in reference 2: navy blue checked ground, ornate cream/gold cooking border, red and black suit marks, chef hat corners, centered gold Battle à la Carte title. Fit that design in perspective into the existing card outline. Keep his left hand pinching the bottom edge exactly, including thumb and curled fingers; do not add fingers or change hand/arm anatomy. Preserve every other part: face, glasses, hair, full body pose, clothing, shoes, relative size, white cutout border, transparent background, native canvas. No new effects, shadows, text outside the card, or extra cards.
